response.overview: In the humid heat of a southern town, two young people carrying secrets of their own collide while trying to escape very different lives. By day, she is a vocational school student determined to study her way north; by night, she punishes the kind of people no one else will. He works as a caregiver in public and secretly earns money solving other people's problems — including a job that requires him to get close to her. What he never expects is to fall for his target for real. In a cramped rental room, secrets and feelings grow together until, during the year she takes the college entrance exam again, she makes the painful choice to cut him out of her life. Ten years later, they meet again and realize that neither ever misunderstood the other's feelings as much as they pretended to.
response.title: Begin Again
